capabilities: merge two or more selected notes via Command Palette or File Explorer
merge source content under matching headings
deduplicate aliases, tags, and Dataview blocks during merge
scan folders for same-name duplicates and auto-merge them
rename notes and merge into an existing target on name collision
extras: Warns that heading comparisons are exact and case-sensitive and advises backing up or using version history before large merges; the secondary note is moved to system trash after a successful merge by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to merge notes, so duplicate files created by copies, renames, or sync conflicts must be combined manually while preserving headings and metadata.

relations.evidence: deduplicate repeated dataview blocks and select the most recently updated dv.view block

summary: Heading-aware merge tool that combines Markdown notes, cleans up same-name duplicates, and reconciles frontmatter and Dataview blocks.
